Salman Khan begins Bigg Boss 20 shoot, interacts with media

Superstar Salman Khan has commenced shooting for the upcoming season of Bigg Boss, titled Bigg Boss 20, which is scheduled to premiere on September 6. Khan was seen on the show's sets sporting a cowboy-inspired look. During a media interaction, Khan appeared to become upset with photographers for not maintaining a suitable distance, with one report quoting him saying, 'Camera Ke Saamne Aane Ki...'. Fans reacted to his appearance, with some commenting on his youthful look.
